clips.title: The story
paras: In Duskwood, the Night Watch holds Darkshire and the forest roads against rising threats. Abandoned by Stormwind's House of Nobles, the local volunteers face undead, feral worgen, and necromancy with Commander Althea Ebonlocke at their head. They depend heavily on travelers to defend their home.

Stormwind withdrew its royal garrison after foul magic consumed the Grand Hamlet and changed the forest into Duskwood. King Varian Wrynn had disappeared, and the troops were recalled to the capital. Left without royal soldiers or supplies, Darkshire's townsfolk formed the Night Watch. They swore to defend Darkshire's borders against the horrors creeping out of the woods.

From its headquarters in Darkshire, the Night Watch patrols roads buried in unnatural mist. Skeletal fiends and ghouls emerge from Raven Hill and Tranquil Gardens cemeteries, while feral worgen prowl Roland's Doom and Brightwood Grove. The militia is badly outnumbered and short of resources, and many of its finest defenders have fallen to threats such as Mor'Ladim, the wandering skeletal warrior.

Commander Althea Ebonlocke, daughter of Darkshire's mayor, directs the defense with grim pragmatism. With no veteran reinforcements, she enlists capable travelers to thin skeletal legions, cull starving wolf packs, and investigate mysterious local murders. The Night Watch is the last barrier protecting human life in the region. If its lines break, Darkshire will fall into shadow.
